name: Receipt printer
description: A small receipt printer that prints the closest pages for a search, row by row, and lets the visitor pull the receipt down to tear it off.

default.k: word processor docx pages ribbon overview writing
features pages ribbon review tables pictures references proofing mail merge templates
download install macos windows linux get
docs documentation guide commands wiki help
apps family formai every app list

labels.baseUrl: Address the page paths belong to
labels.placeholder: Address shown when none is known

propDocs.pages: Array of {t, p, k}: page title, path and keywords. The receipt scores every query against title, path and keywords with the same fuzzy rules as the original.
propDocs.fallback: Titles from the pages list used to pad the receipt to three pages.
propDocs.labels: Object with every word printed on the receipt and the tear hints.
propDocs.searchInput: Node id of the search field. Typing prints after a short pause and Enter prints at once; the field's words become the receipt query.
propDocs.searchButton: Node id of the button that prints the receipt.
propDocs.addressNode: Node id of a text element that receives the address that was not found (the from parameter, else the placeholder).
propDocs.siteResults: Node id of the hidden list that the native site search action fills. Its results are printed first, ahead of the pages list.

fallback: With reduced motion the receipt prints fully at once, the lamp does not blink and the tear drop is instant. The tear gesture and the Reprint button stay usable.
